I'm often late to the party and things like this, but I just turned on (Amazon) Prime Video to watch a live, European soccer match only to see the Green Mountain Championship also playing live. 

It's a nice surprise. I remember when it was a big deal when disc golf was mentioned on ESPN. A year or two ago, "old" tourney coverage would play late at night on Peacock or Paramount.

Now this.

Anybody up for a round this evening?
I’ll play anywhere 💁🏻‍♂️

# ***Last Call!! LoCo Open is waiting for you!***

Do you like massive ace bounties? Do you have what it takes to shred in the woods? Come on out at tame the monster Biscoe designed! 

LoCo Open endeavors to one up the event every year and this year won't disappoint. 

There are flex events the weekend prior. There will be a players party Oct 3 at Flying Ace brewery. All in all, it will be super chill throwing with your friends. Come on out, LoCo will make you feel at home.

[https://www.discgolfscene.com/tournament/Fifteenth_Annual_LoCo_Open_Ams_2026](https://www.discgolfscene.com/tournament/Fifteenth_Annual_LoCo_Open_Ams_2026)

Come see us on Saturday night 9-19 at Cider Lab by Spotsylvania Courthouse during the SPAM event. We will be there from 630-9pm with a few baskets for games, slot shot, and cornhole. There is also a raffle drawing for some passes to TPWDGC(be sure to see previous posts on how to buy in). @[100077682637530:2048:Cider lab - Spotsylvania] has great food as well as ciders. Dont have to be a player of the event to enjoy the fun. Bring your family and I hope to see you all there.
